notes.title: Meet Headshot ver.2.0!
notes.content:
Added support for Value Index controllers and added a new map!

To work with Valve Index controllers, we suggest that when starting the game, select the "Settings" item in the menu and set a smooth rotation angle there and select Valve Index controllers.

notes.title: Update 1.6-Super Bots
notes.content:
Completely redesigned artificial intelligence in the offline game mode. Artificial intelligence works on the basis of "Behavior Trees", which are used for the development of class AAA games, which allowed us to gain control over any aspects of artificial intelligence in the game, in order to further complicate and improve the system. Finally, we introduced the ability to choose the difficulty levels for bots. If the bots seem too difficult, then you can always lower the difficulty level of the game. And if you want something special, then we have a "Suicide" difficulty mode, the essence of which is that you can be killed from the first hit. Difficulty modes in the future will be reconfigured and improved by us, at the moment we will collect statistics to understand what we can then improve for you.
Removed many bugs related to the menu and the game as a whole.
Redesigned many colliders in the game, for more accurate interaction with players.

notes.title: v1.0RC1 UPDATE
notes.content:
Today 1.0rc1 update of our game Headshot VR is published.

This is a very serious update, a lot of visible changes, even more invisible, but noticeable: stability has been improved, some bugs have been fixed (not all, but many).
So, meet version 1.0rc1:

Added:

 Localization (English, Russian, Chinese, German, Spanish)
Our users have requested localization in multiple languages. We don’t have too much text in the game, we’ve all (almost) translated. If there are inaccuracies in the translation - please write in support.
https://i.imgur.com/64Qqoe6.jpg

 New 3D-design of the main menu
The main menu we have now is amazing (well, we like it), all the graphics settings, character settings, slots, the transition to online and offline games are made from one location - the menu. I hope you will like it
https://media.giphy.com/media/1bEJpRZLLGRfScdCTQ/giphy.gif

 New design of other menus. The wristband menu is also slightly modified and what menu we still have there is - I don’t remember.
https://i.imgur.com/qjpZZpK.jpg

 Music on the menu
Without music, it’s very sad, we made music on the menu
 Transitions between screens in the form of white balls
 The sound of a passing bullet
 Particles at steps
 Effect - Particles on character respawn
 Displays the last shots that caused the player to die - after death you can see who and from what point he killed you in battle.
https://media.giphy.com/media/2YpOZhzcGykpz77Y1m/giphy.gif

 Death Camera
 Spectator camera - after death, you can fly over the stage and watch it


Improved:

 New sounds
 Plume from the shot
 The head is now fixed in size, without affecting the character’s scale.
 Green marks on gun sights to facilitate aiming
https://media.giphy.com/media/54YeLObYlNFElilkX5/giphy.gif

 Shotgun and sniper reload with one hand
 Reduced damage when shooting bots
 Changing the aiming logic
 2 times faster reload
 Smooth sniper rifle rendering
https://media.giphy.com/media/fiyQNmbi0ikae1J4Gr/giphy.gif
 Sniper rifle now works on both eyes


Fixed:

 Game freezes when exiting
 Random reloads at the end of the sprint
 Many minor fixes

Work does not stand still - so go in, play, the more players in the game - the more interesting!
And again, please report all bugs

notes.title: v0.8 and v0.7 Update
notes.content:
Hello!
Today we have released a new update, v0.8. And about the previous update forgot to write the news.

Therefore, I correct this error and write here about updates 0.7 and 0.8
(and what happened to 0.6?)

I'll start with version v0.7
[olist]
 We divided the movement and turns into different controllers - for both the Vive and the Oculus. Try, move and jump - on the left joystick, turns - on the right. Later we will make a setting in the menu, so that you yourself can determine where the movement is and where it turns.
 We added different turn options. There are 3 of them:

 Angle - a turn at a certain angle, 90, 45, 15 degrees by tap on the touch button (or tilting the Oculus stick):
https://media.giphy.com/media/FDkHC3C6jGKqQfQyew/giphy.gif

 Snap - turn in the direction of the hand with the weapon. By clicking on the touch button or stick:
https://media.giphy.com/media/5nq6Ctxr1HXAGqOWMC/giphy.gif

 Smooth - smooth turn, non-stop. May be fast-medium-slow:
https://media.giphy.com/media/9MIHZXufE563gzNmVQ/giphy.gif


 Fixed some problems with spawn.
[/olist]

Now go to version 0.8.
[olist]
 When you start the game, we now show how many users are currently connected to the game. 
https://i.imgur.com/XktCth5.jpg
 When creating multiplayer battle, you can play a mini-game with targets while other players are connected. As soon as several people connect, the multiplayer game will start.
https://media.giphy.com/media/7AaDaa6psOOhncoE8z/giphy.gif

 Players receive a notification when someone joins the game.
 Made some improvements on optimization.
[/olist]

We are working on further improving the game and optimizing it. Stay with us!

notes.title: v0.5 Update - New Game Modes, New Map, ...
notes.content:
Hello guys!

Yes, we all understood that we had released the game earlier than necessary (and the one who pressed the “start sales” button is already punished). We cannot return to the past. Therefore, we should only systematically and persistently improve the game.

The last few updates have significantly improved gameplay (see previous updates):
- realized some wishes of users on controls and gameplay
- fixed fifty bugs and several among them, affecting FPS subsidence in the game.

We really try to make the game better.

The current update brought the following changes to our game:
Added:

 New game modes Bomb, TeamBattle
 Added match mode selection (first select the mode, then the map)
 New "Town" map
 New “Tutorial” map

Improved:

 Changed the Team Deathmatch game mode 
 Match duration in all multiplayer mode games - 5 minutes
 Changed "Tutorial" location
 Changed Tutorial mode (changed learning logic)
 Changed the Shooting range mode, only one mode, but you can already shoot at targets and choose a weapon


Now for some of the changes in detail

New game modes (relevant for multiplayer), now there are 3 of them in total
TeamDeathmatch - Our most favorite game mode, quick play with respawns. Team play per team. Each team starts the game in their respawn points. After death, the player is reborn at the respawn point and continues to fight. The team that gets more frags in 5 minutes wins.

https://i.imgur.com/7v6hcQa.jpg

TeamBattle - a mode of play without rebirth after death. The game lasts until one of the teams wins 8 times.

https://i.imgur.com/jIU5WRR.jpg

Bomb - mode of the game with a bomb. To win, you need to destroy the enemy team or complete the task (the task of the terrorists is to detonate a bomb, special forces - to neutralize the bomb). The game continues 15 rounds: the team that wins the first 8 times wins

https://media.giphy.com/media/2cdYrpqnkwNXlG7QX9/giphy.gif

New “Town” map:

https://i.imgur.com/DxNhTSM.jpg

New Shooting range location: 
The shooting range has become more beautiful and comfortable.

https://media.giphy.com/media/7IW6vLFZNzMvz1YkSd/giphy.gif
You can use all these weapons in the game - you only need to set your character in the menu.

New Tutorial mode:
https://media.giphy.com/media/2wWZWoxCHE62koHwQM/giphy.gif

Height calibration:
https://media.giphy.com/media/1gWi7OD6Lwt3sr4oqS/giphy.gif

Roadmap

We understand that the development of the game should not be limited only to eliminating bugs, so we suggest seeing the roadmap of the next improvements and new features of our game.

The actual version of the roadmap is always here: http://headshotvr.com/roadmap/


 Development of a new 3D menu (setting the parameters of the game, setting up a character, interactive height calibration)
 Optimization of program code and game maps (improved FPS)
 New types of weapons, different lethal power for weapons.
 Visual improvements and features (traces on the walls and ground).
 Sound enhancements (adding sounds of the world, musical accompaniment).
 Improving the death camera (visibility of the bullet trajectory, the visibility of the enemy who killed the character)
 Mini-map to indicate the location of the enemy.
 Different shooting ranges will be added to enable shooting practice.
 Start of gun-stock sales for HTC Vive and Oculus CV1 controllers.
 A manual weapon reload will be added (as requested by many players).
 Functionality of quick connection to the game without entering the “Multiplayer” menu.
 Connecting Discord service for communication between players.
 The social functionality: the search for friends, etc. will be added.
 The leaderboard in shooting competitions and in different game modes will be added.
 Destructible elements on the map will be added.


If in this list you did not see your wishes for the game - write to us in the discussion on Steam https://steamcommunity.com/app/903710/discussions/  or Discord 

About all the bugs feel free to write! We will fix everything!

Today we published the next update! We continue to work on improving the game!

 To take a weapon with two hands you need to press the grip
 Rotate 90 degrees by swipe


v0.3

 Wrong calculation of turning a two-handed weapon

Improved:
